name: Asking for Clarification
equipment: A notebook and a colleague or mirror to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on asking for clarification -- practice these key phrases out loud:
Sorry, could you clarify what you mean by that?
Just to make sure I understand -- are you saying...?
Could you walk me through that one more time?
When you say 'soon,' do you have a specific date in mind?
Try using at least two of these phrases in a short role-play scenario at work.
